package.name: sidewalk_navigation
package.description: Goal-driven navigation on the saved camera map (September 2026 design). On top of a running localisation (RTAB-Map in localisation mode, wheels + gyroscope + camera blend), it adds a map server for the saved 2D map, camera obstacle points from the ZED X depth, move_base with the DWA local planner, and a guarded command link: wheel commands leave the Jetson only through nav_cmd_sender.py and reach the robot only through nav_cmd_recv.py while the operator holds the autonomy button. Includes the goal routes driven in September, the exported maps, the sim dry-run, and the scoring scripts. Started by run/navigate.sh.
package.author: Thaw Zin
